key_insight: DR-net-Mamba combines convolutional local feature extraction with Mamba selective state-space blocks to capture long-range ECG context for more effective denoising than standard CNN-based methods.
engineering_relevance: It offers a linear-complexity alternative to transformers for scalable ECG denoising in long ambulatory recordings, with potential benefits for downstream diagnosis.
method: Insert Mamba selective state-space blocks at the convolutional bottleneck
Use hybrid local-plus-long-range temporal modeling for denoising
Evaluate reconstruction, robustness, scaling, and diagnostic impact
evidence_signal: Across synthetic and real ECG datasets, the model achieved the best SNR and lowest RMSE, and it also improved macro AUROC over denoiser baselines across two independent classifiers.
watch_item: Calibration gains are not universal across classifier backends, so deployment should verify both denoising quality and classifier-specific reliability on the target pipeline.
paper_title: DR-net-Mamba: Selective State-Space Modeling for Long-Range ECG Time-Series Denoising
